title: Curvilinear Villa & Penthouse Pool
tagline: Striking curvilinear timber facade with a private rooftop swimming pool
description: An avant-garde residential statement in Ambikapur featuring an undulating timber louvre facade and sweeping curved glass balconies. The top tier features a private rooftop swimming pool flanked by treated wood decking, cascading water spouts, and a sunset lounge.

details.Key Elements: Rooftop Swimming Pool, Curvilinear Wood Facade, Sunset Deck, Statement Round Bed Master Suite
